description: This file provides utility functions for parsing and splitting command line strings, particularly handling Windows executable paths and command wrappers. It defines regex patterns and functions to process command strings across platforms, with specific attention to Windows executable formats and wrappers.

methods.name: splitCommandParts
methods.description: Splits a command string into its constituent parts, respecting quotes and escape sequences, for platform-specific handling.

methods.name: splitWindowsExecutableCommand
methods.description: Detects and splits Windows direct executable commands, extracting command and arguments.

methods.name: assertSupportedWindowsCommand
methods.description: Validates that Windows command wrappers are invoked properly with supported shells or interpreters.

methods.name: splitCommandLine
methods.description: Main exported function that parses a full command line, handling Windows-specific edge cases, and returns command and arguments.
